> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Phare: The Cambodian Circus in Siem Reap offers a 60-minute performance of theater, modern dance, and acrobatics, presented by graduates of an elite performing arts school founded by nine men returning from Khmer Rouge refugee camps. AGS secures 'Section A' VIP seating, including chilled water and a cooling fan.
> *   The experience, with a total duration of 1.5 hours, is characterized by an energetic, theatrical, and emotional atmosphere, often cited as the most emotionally moving cultural experience for guests. It is best paired with an evening prior to a late dinner in Siem Reap.
> *   AGS provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this year-round, advance-booking-required experience, ensuring a seamless luxury experience with a smart casual dress code.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Witness a breathtaking fusion of theater, modern dance, and jaw-dropping acrobatics. Phare tells profound Cambodian stories while supporting an incredible social enterprise.

## The Operator & Origin Story
More than just a circus, Phare Ponleu Selpak was founded by nine young men returning from refugee camps after the fall of the Khmer Rouge. Art and performance were used as trauma therapy. Today, it is an elite performing arts school, and the circus in Siem Reap features their most incredible graduates delivering high-energy, emotionally charged narratives.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Your concierge secures 'Section A' VIP seating, the absolute core center of the big top. You will be provided with chilled water and a cooling fan. 

The 60-minute performance relies on phenomenal physical strength, humor, and live, pulsating music. The stories range from historical folk tales to modern societal challenges. Guests frequently cite this as the most emotionally moving cultural experience of their trip.

## Effortless Evening Entertainment After 18 Holes at Angkor Golf Resort or Phokeethra
Situated inside its iconic red big-top tent near the Ring Road in Siem Reap—just 8 minutes from [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), and [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/)—**Phare: The Cambodian Circus VIP** is one of the easiest high-impact cultural evenings to pair with a full day of golf. Because the show runs a crisp 60 minutes (8:00 PM to 9:00 PM) with zero walking required, players who completed a morning or midday round at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/), [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), or [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/) can enjoy an early 6:00 PM dinner at [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/) or [The Sugar Palm](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-the-sugar-palm-siem-reap/) and arrive at the tent 15 minutes before curtain call.

## Section-A VIP Seating & Backstage Artist Access
* **Reserved Front-Center Sightlines:** Asia Golf Specialists secures elevated Section-A VIP seats directly facing the center ring, complete with a welcome cocktail or craft beer, a refillable insulated Phare water bottle, a woven souvenir fan, and dedicated cooling fans.
* **Post-Show Performer Meet-and-Greet:** Following the finale—which blends live percussion, contemporary dance, contortion, and fire juggling into a modern Cambodian story—VIP guests enjoy priority stage access to photograph and speak with the Battambang-trained artists before stepping into a waiting air-conditioned SUV.

## Coordinating Dinner, Golf & Big-Top Transfers Across Siem Reap
Because the Phare big-top arena sits on the western side of Siem Reap between [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/) and the Old Market dining precinct, transfer times from every major golf resort and five-star property remain under 12 minutes. After a morning tee sheet at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), our concierge recommends a 5:45 PM early seating at [Mahob Khmer Cuisine](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-mahob-khmer-cooking-class/) or [The Sugar Palm](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-the-sugar-palm-siem-reap/), followed by a 7:40 PM VIP arrival at the tent and a 9:15 PM nightcap at [Asana Old Wooden House](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-asana-wooden-house-siem-reap/).

faqs.q: Can we attend Phare: The Cambodian Circus on the same day as an 18-hole round in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the performance starts at 8:00 PM and lasts just 60 minutes in reserved Section-A VIP seating, it pairs seamlessly after a morning round at Angkor Golf Resort or Phokeethra Country Club and an early dinner in Siem Reap.

faqs.q: What perks are included with Phare Section-A VIP tickets booked through Asia Golf Specialists?
faqs.a: Section-A VIP access includes front-center reserved seating without queuing, a welcome drink, an insulated souvenir water bottle, priority post-show photo access with the performers, and door-to-door luxury SUV transfers.

faqs.q: Does Phare use animals in its Siem Reap circus performances?
faqs.a: No. Phare Ponleu Selpak is a contemporary theatrical circus modeled after Cirque du Soleil, combining human acrobatics, live traditional music, modern theatre, and visual arts performed by graduates of its Battambang arts school.
